# ---------------------------------------------------------------- unity through détente
COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_ready = {
	check_variable = { cwgg_u_phase = 0 }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = cwgg_unity_cd }
	has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_GER_1970_european_peace_order
	check_variable = { cwgg_klima > 69 }
	check_variable = { cwgg_stufe = 0 }
	check_variable = { cwgg_krise_typ = 0 }
	check_variable = { cwgg_detente_m > 35 }
	check_variable = { cwgg_vertrag_3 = 1 }
	check_variable = { cwgg_vertrag_5 = 1 }
	check_variable = { cwgg_vertrag_6 = 1 }
	OR = { check_variable = { cwgg_vertrag_7 = 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_vertrag_8 = 1 } }
	country_exists = DDR
	NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_unity_achieved }
	NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_confederation }
	NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GER_1970_dark_regime }
	NOT = { has_war_with = DDR }
	date > 1975.1.1
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_can_propose = {
	COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_ready = yes
	check_variable = { cwgg_init_brd > 2 }
	has_political_power > 99
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_can_ddr_propose = {
	GER = { COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_ready = yes check_variable = { cwgg_init_ddr > 2 } }
	has_political_power > 99
}

COLDWAR_GER_1970_uni_talking = {
	check_variable = { cwgg_u_phase > 1 }
}

	NOT = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_pos = 1 } }
